meta.name: xAPI verbs
meta.about: The six xAPI verbs HAX elements send and which of 38 elements sends each, generated from user-action/lib/xapi-vocabulary.json. Green elements count toward completion.

v_experienced.desc: The learner opened or saw it. Never required for completion. Sent by 7 elements.

v_attempted.desc: The learner started it. Sent by 11 elements.

v_progressed.desc: The learner got part way; media and multi-step activities report progress. Sent by 13 elements.

v_completed.desc: The learner finished it as the element defines done. Sent by 16 elements.

v_answered.desc: The learner gave an answer; result carries success and the response. Sent by 19 elements.

v_interacted.desc: The learner did something with it that is not an answer. Sent by 3 elements.

x_a11y_collapse.desc: Sends experienced on user-engagement. Done means: opened by the learner (one already open when the page loads has nothing to open and does not count) Counts toward completion.

x_a11y_media_player.desc: Sends attempted, progressed, completed on user-engagement. Done means: every quarter of the media actually watched (90% of its seconds), or the first three and the player reaching its end; seeking ahead does not count, and each milestone is sent once per learner Counts toward completion.
x_a11y_media_player.note: object type media; result: completion, duration, extensions.https://w3id.org/xapi/video/extensions/progress

x_arithmetic_drill.desc: Sends attempted, progressed, completed on user-engagement. Done means: a run finished: every problem answered, or the timer ran out Counts toward completion.
x_arithmetic_drill.note: object type simulation; result: completion, score, duration, extensions.https://haxtheweb.org/xapi/extensions/progress

tours.label: What learners generate
tours.message: Six verbs, 38 elements that send them, all from one vocabulary file so every statement is shaped the same way.

scenes.caption: Every HAX activity speaks xAPI through one shared vocabulary.
Six verbs cover everything an element reports.
Attempted, progressed, completed: media, games and multi-step activities.
Experienced and interacted: things a learner opened or touched.
Statements feed Insights and describe learning in a course.
